facts.business: GKW Limited operates in warehousing business providing lease rentals and investment and treasury activities including dividend and interest income.

capacity_or_capex.item: Refurbishing/re-construction of covered sheds and buildings

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is actively pursuing further expansion of the warehousing area and related infrastructure to develop comprehensive warehousing & logistic hub at Howrah.

key_risks: Stock market volatility and sensitivity due to geopolitical tensions and energy price increases
Delay in recovery of investments due to market volatility
facts.related_party_note: Joint Development Agreement with Anthurium Developers Limited, a subsidiary of Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited, for development of land admeasuring 36.87 acres situated at Village Kanjur.
